material_composition.why_this_material_short: Living produce consumes oxygen and exhales carbon dioxide. Solid plastic suffocates fresh produce within 48 hours, causing anaerobic rotting. Laser micro-perforations maintain an optimal equilibrium atmosphere (3-5% O2, 5-8% CO2) while preventing water condensation droplets via anti-fog additives.
